facts.value: Staff Mobility for Teaching allows UL teaching staff to teach at a partner university abroad in any subject area/academic discipline with a minimum of 8 hours teaching required.
facts.programme_association: Work and Organisational Psychology / Work and Organisational Behaviour - MSc

facts.value: Staff Mobility for Training allows UL teaching and non-teaching staff to undertake job shadowing/observation or attend training events (excluding conferences) at a partner university or at another relevant organisation abroad. A period abroad can combine teaching and training activities.
facts.programme_association: Work and Organisational Psychology / Work and Organisational Behaviour - MSc

facts.value: Staff Mobility for Teaching and Training allows staff members to complete a combination of teaching and training activities as part of their mobility with a minimum of 4 hours teaching required.
